en.t: If this is how it must be, you would have done better to refuse me outright.

units.source_text: 有一个侍女是小姐的乳母的女儿，称作侍从的，口齿伶俐，长于应对，

en.t: One of the gentlewoman attendants was the daughter of the young lady's nurse; she was called Jiju, and was quick-tongued and skillful in replies,

units.source_text: 看见小姐这般模样，心中着急，觉得太不礼貌，

en.t: and seeing the young lady in such a state, she grew anxious and thought it far too discourteous,

units.source_text: 便走近小姐身旁，代她答复道：

en.t: so she went close to the young lady and answered in her place:
